Work the five harvest grounds around the anchorage.
rules: Stillwater reuses the Deepwater Claim reef terrain.
Five harvest grounds ring the Claim-Boat.
Waves enter from the north and south.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.

data.reason: no boat-build or reanchor verb exists on the agent tool surface

heardWhile: air-pump: the harvest CHANNEL is engaged (the HARVEST verb hand-pans and is silent)
engine: the boat is under way after a REANCHOR
harpoon-reload: the deck ballista fired
data.loudness: the declared radius of a running source; the loudest audible one is trailed
data.strikeTarget: the deck nearest the trailed machine; the hero is never struck

nextWave.compositionScope: wave-horn packs only; continuous tricklers are additional
